integrity: Two standalone exact integer programs independently enumerate all 297200 tables, transform all \(2^{25}\) reduced characters, and verify residues, zeros, gap and Parseval. Independent external mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for labelled 6-by-6 binary matrices of row and column sum three; exhaustive integer verification is finite and does not imply arbitrary-size formulas; historical priority subject to unindexed evaluations.
title: Exact complement-even Walsh recovery for six-by-six balanced binary tables
